# Namespace

A folder for definitions: agents, interactions, apps and the rest are deployed into a namespace.

**Kind:** an object, used in responses.

## Fields

Every field is present in a response; empty ones are `null`.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | The namespace's name, unique within the tenant. Routes that take `{namespaceName}` use it. |
| `defaultWebDownloadPartitionId` | `uuid \| null` | The temporary knowledge base (partition) that web pages fetched by runs of this namespace's definitions are kept in, when a run's start names none. Null: the tenant's default applies. |
| `tenantId` | `uuid` | The id of the tenant it belongs to. |
| `id` | `uuid` | The unique id. Use it in `by-id` routes and wherever another object refers to this one. |
| `dateCreated` | `datetime` | When it was created, in UTC. |
| `dateUpdated` | `datetime` | When it was last changed, in UTC. |

## Example

```json
{
  "name": "...",
  "defaultWebDownloadPartitionId": "3f2b8c1e-5d4a-4e6b-9c7d-2a1b0c9d8e7f",
  "tenantId": "3f2b8c1e-5d4a-4e6b-9c7d-2a1b0c9d8e7f",
  "id": "3f2b8c1e-5d4a-4e6b-9c7d-2a1b0c9d8e7f",
  "dateCreated": "2026-10-26T12:00:00.0000000Z",
  "dateUpdated": "2026-10-26T12:00:00.0000000Z"
}
```

## Where it's used

- [`namespaces.create`](../api/namespaces.md) (`POST /namespaces`)
- [`namespaces.getById`](../api/namespaces.md) (`GET /namespaces/by-id/{id}`)
- [`namespaces.get`](../api/namespaces.md) (`GET /namespaces/by-name/{name}`)
- [`namespaces.list`](../api/namespaces.md) (`GET /namespaces`)
- [`namespaces.rename`](../api/namespaces.md) (`PUT /namespaces/by-id/{id}`)
